summary: Contestants complete the accounting cycle for different business types, apply accounting standards, and prepare and analyze financial statements. The event tests accuracy, compliance, and decision-making skills using accounting systems and automation tools. Only secondary division students may enter, and contestants must follow strict equipment and material guidelines.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes for orientation
No more than ninety (90) minutes for testing
No more than ten (10) minutes for wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
competencies: Execute and analyze the accounting cycle using accounting systems and automation tools to ensure accuracy, compliance, and efficiency
Apply GAAP and relevant international standards to assess and report the value of assets, liabilities, and equity
Apply accounting principles across service, merchandising, and various business structures
Analyze and record business and equity transactions using integrated accounting platforms, emphasizing automation, audit trails, and compliance
Evaluate and manage uncollectible accounts using predictive analytics within accounting platforms
Apply depreciation methods within accounting systems, incorporating tax regulations and asset lifecycle management
Calculate and analyze interest using financial modeling tools, with emphasis on real-time data and compliance
Apply inventory valuation methods using inventory management systems integrated with accounting platforms
Prepare, interpret, and analyze financial statements, emphasizing real-time data to support decision-making
Perform departmental allocations using integrated financial systems, focusing on cost centers, shared services, and performance metrics
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests or facsimiles (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Contestants may not enter Fundamental Accounting and Advanced Accounting in the same year.
